summary: Wait for transient console monitor process observations during background startup
details: Background up retries transient process permission and disappearance errors for up to five seconds while checking the console monitor release. Each attempt refreshes systemd state and MainPID, avoiding a stale PID across process startup or replacement.

Post-start verification also waits briefly for a PID and release stamp to become visible. Persistent observation errors, missing stamps, failed services and processes running another release still prevent background startup from reporting success.

Timeout diagnostics include the failure type, PID and errno when available without exporting process environment contents. Existing custom-unit protections and generated-unit migration remain in effect; a healthy current observer is not restarted merely because one observation was temporarily unreadable.
